description: This file defines the AccountMenuController class, a controller for managing account menu UI state and interactions in a web application, including observable properties, actions, and event handling.

classes.name: AccountMenuController
classes.description: Controller class managing the account menu UI state, including properties for visibility, sign-out status, server info, encryption status, and current UI pane.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the controller, destroying object properties.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets up observables, and subscribes to application events.

methods.name: setShow
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the account menu.

methods.name: setShouldAnimateClose
methods.description: Sets whether the menu should animate when closing.

methods.name: closeAccountMenu
methods.description: Closes the account menu with animation and resets current pane.

methods.name: setShowSignIn
methods.description: Shows or hides the sign-in UI.

methods.name: setShowRegister
methods.description: Shows or hides the registration UI.

methods.name: toggleShow
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the account menu.

methods.name: setOtherSessionsSignOut
methods.description: Sets the sign-out status for other sessions.

methods.name: notesAndTagsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of notes and tags.
